name: Player Rig
description: One rig per player: a nameplate and a health bar that follow every avatar, with hit points the Multiplayer Server owns. Clients render the rig; the server decides how much health anyone actually has.

changelog.notes: Initial release: one rig per player with a nameplate and health bar that follow the avatar, a right-hand anchor for held items, hit points the server owns, and a gun script that reports its hits for the server to check
